agents.name: Backend
agents.title: Booking API

options.kickoff: Start a huddle with Frontend about the booking confirmation response (what POST /bookings returns). Propose a first shape, settle it with Frontend in a few exchanges, then end the huddle with the agreed shape written out exactly. Don't write code.

lessons: Bookings have id, start, end (UTC ISO), tz (IANA) and practitionerId.

agents.name: Frontend
agents.title: Booking UI
lessons: The confirmation screen shows the clinic's name and address, and a cancel link, so it needs all three from the API without a second call.
